ETH Cinco de Mayo is a three days hackathon that blends intensive competition with onboarding and deep educational outreach (https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1j4DOe-06_OMuYQwZIAa0LKmlsrKiCLr9F-CBZ0ksbrg/edit?pli=1#slide=id.p). The format is built around three main components:

Our goals are to boost blockchain education and onboarding, foster collaboration among communities and companies, drive innovation, and build a robust, inclusive ecosystem in LATAM. details:
``20 Days of QA” is a virtual and community-driven challenge where participants test real decentralized applications (dApps) across the Ethereum ecosystem. The goal is to improve the quality and usability of Web3 applications while introducing experienced Web2 professionals and curious newcomers to blockchain testing practices.

The program runs asynchronously for 20 days and includes daily 30-minute sessions (audio + video), bug reporting, public dashboards, and community feedback. We start by testing key wallets (MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, Uniswap Wallet, Trust Wallet) and expand through an open call for other dApps. Participation is open, free, and remote, with all deliverables published publicly.

This event bridges the gap between traditional QA and Web3, encouraging hands-on contribution, community knowledge sharing, and real value delivery to dApp teams ahead of Devconnect.
name: Road to Devconnect: 20 días de QA en Apps Descentralizadas

details:
The B2B Roundtable Day aims to create a high-impact, collaborative space where executives from the manufacturing and supply chain industries meet with technology experts, developers, and innovators to share real business challenges and explore how disruptive technologies like blockchain, AI, and automation can address them effectively.

Traditional industries are facing increasing complexity: fragmented systems, inefficient processes, payment bottlenecks, and barriers to scale. Despite the hype, many companies still struggle to connect these pain points with applicable technological solutions.
This event bridges that gap by facilitating small, focused roundtable discussions between industry decision-makers and tech builders. Instead of abstract presentations, we prioritize listening to real-world issues and collaboratively identifying where existing or emerging tech can drive tangible results.

Unlike other innovation events, this roundtable is built on co-creation. It is not about explaining blockchain—it's about understanding unmet needs, uncovering inefficiencies, and highlighting real use cases and successful benchmarks, both local and global.
This bottom-up approach is critical to:
- Encourage digital transformation in industries that need it the most
- Inspire developers and startups to build solutions that matter
- Foster long-term collaboration between traditional businesses and Web3-native innovators

Expected Outcomes: 
- A clearer understanding of where traditional systems fall short
- A prioritized list of common challenges across industry segments
- Exposure to use cases and technologies that are already delivering results
- New connections between business leaders and technical talent
- Momentum to co-design prototypes or proof-of-concepts to be used during Path to Devconnect (e.g. hackathons) and showcase at Devconnect
name: B2B Day Vol. 1 – Manufacturing & Supply Chain Executives Roundtable

details:
This event is happening soon because we want to onboard and prepare local Chilean developers to participate in Crecimiento’s Hackathon (the largest Web3 hackathon in Latin America) and to encourage them to apply for scholarships and attend DevConnect in November. Timing is crucial, since the hackathon is already underway and we want our builders to have the tools, support, and momentum to make strong submissions and to connect with the global community.
The estimated cost of the event is $1,000 USD, which covers:
	•	Food, coffee, and drinks for participants (full-day event).
	•	Event space.
	•	A small amount of merch (already produced).
	•	Workshops with top-tier local Web3 developers.
I am personally covering these expenses out of pocket, as our funding sponsor declined last minute and I want the event to go on forward regardless. A grant or confirmation of reimbursement from EF would be incredibly helpful and impactful. Even if the confirmation comes later and the support is retroactive, I would personally really appreciate it. 
Why this is important
	•	This will be one of the first steps to showcase Chile’s presence in the Ethereum ecosystem ahead of DevConnect.
	•	We will onboard up to 25 young developers and university students into the hackathon, giving them the chance to compete, gain skills, and represent the region in this hack.
	•	We are creating visibility for Chile in the global ETH community by documenting the event with photos, content, and sharing across Crecimiento, Campus On-Chain, and local community channels.
	•	Many of us organizers are already confirmed to attend DevConnect; this event expands that presence by preparing and inviting more young minds to join the journey.
We believe this is a unique opportunity for amplifying Chile’s role in Latin America’s Web3 movement and strengthening the next generation of Eth builders.

Dynamics:Day 0.5 → Kickoff: team formation, guided ideation, and challenge definition.
Day 1 → Building: intensive work with technical workshops, mentorship, and checkpoints.
Day 2 → Wrap-up: prototype polishing, pitch training, and final presentations.

At Ethereum Lima we created Puqi, the little builder llama that inspires the community.
Puqi is a cultural and narrative strategist that translates complexity into something close and relatable, builds memorability, and creates an emotional bridge with new users. In this Bootcamp, Puqi will be the guiding thread of the experience—leading participants through dynamics, storytelling, and community rituals.

Real adoption: 100+ participants in Peru and LATAM building their first experiences on Arbitrum.
Open content: all materials (slides, guides, dynamics) will remain available onchain for replication in other communities.
Sustainable community: we form teams that integrate into the Ethereum Lima network and global Arbitrum initiatives.
Cultural impact: by integrating Puqi’s narrative, we amplify local identity while globalizing the experience without losing authenticity.




Strategy:
Pre event: Bootcamp to be the first step in a bigger bridge: from Lima to LATAM, (4 oct- 20 oct)

120+ hackers forming teams of 3–5 members
40+ innovative projects presented
300+ attendees across workshops, talks, and final pitches
15+ local and regional Web3 communities involved

ETH Coffee Rave is an interactive community event designed to make Web3 accessible to complete beginners in a fun, zero-risk environment. On August 27th, Café Nómada in Buenos Aires will become a hub where attendees can experience their very first crypto transaction: purchasing a coffee with ETH — even if they’ve never touched cryptocurrency before. content.en: Join 'From Latin America, Ethereum for the World' on August 1, 2025! This hybrid hackathon offers virtual sessions and an in-person day with workshops, mentorship, and networking. Open to women, students, developers, and anyone curious about Web3 and Ethereum. Free and inclusive!
content.es: ¡Participa en 'Desde Latinoamérica, Ethereum para el Mundo' el 1 de agosto de 2025! Hackathon híbrido con sesiones virtuales y un día presencial con talleres, mentoría y networking. Abierto a mujeres, estudiantes, desarrolladores y curiosos de Web3 y Ethereum. ¡Gratis e inclusivo!
content.pt: Participe do 'Da América Latina, Ethereum para o Mundo' em 1º de agosto de 2025! Hackathon híbrido com sessões virtuais e um dia presencial com oficinas, mentoria e networking. Aberto para mulheres, estudantes, desenvolvedores e curiosos por Web3 e Ethereum. Gratuito e inclusivo!

target_audience: Women, students, Web3-curious individuals, developers, and anyone interested in exploring the Ethereum ecosystem.
details:
Hybrid event that combines 1-hour virtual sessions focused on delivering introductory knowledge and basic Ethereum theory, along with an in-person day featuring an ideathon format, activations, mentorship, and networking opportunities.

-- Virtual Sessions --
Why Should Ethereum Matter in Latin America - Elba Chávez (Lead, H.E.R DAO México)

Usability vs. Necessity: Building DeFi Solutions - Yedid Romero (Lead, H.E.R DAO México)

Governance and Community: The Heart of Ethereum - Tory Dom (Arbitrum Ambassador)

-- In-Person Ideathon --
Hosted in Zacatlán, Mexico from August 1 - 2 during Unlock Summit 2025

Bring together local talent, students, entrepreneurs, and experts to design no-code prototypes that address regional challenges

Themes: Agriculture, DeFi

Tentative Topics:
 - Overview of the From Latin America, Ethereum for the World program
- How Ethereum & blockchain offers solutions to local challenges in Zacatlán
- What is Road to Devconnect
- How to create a business model
- Preparing a high-impact pitch

Tentative Speakers
- Elba Chávez (Lead, H.E.R DAO México)
- Jistro (Arbitrum Ambassador)
- Fertello (Co-Founder, CriptoUNAM)

The main challenge in states like Puebla, Mexico, and throughout Latin America remains the lack of access to technical education that is understandable for people from any professional background, as well as the scarcity of practical resources in Spanish about Ethereum and blockchain.

To address this issue, we propose a hybrid event that combines one-hour virtual sessions focused on delivering introductory knowledge and basic Ethereum theory, along with an in-person day featuring a hackathon format, activations, mentorship, and networking opportunities.

This structure is designed to maximize both the reach and the depth of the content shared. On the one hand, the virtual sessions remove geographical barriers and allow for broad participation; on the other, the in-person event offers hands-on experiences, direct interaction with experts, and strengthens the local ecosystem of developers and enthusiasts.

Our initiative not only aims to educate but also to build lasting connections and foster Latin America’s integration into the onchain ecosystem in an inclusive and sustainable way.

We are committed to promoting accessible and collaborative learning spaces, with free and open admission for anyone interested in exploring the potential of Ethereum and decentralized technologies.
name: From Latin America, Ethereum for the World

Gira SEED is a nationwide tour of meetups across Argentina, designed to accelerate Ethereum and Web3 adoption through local activation. Each stop is a gateway for students, builders, and professionals to connect, learn, and join the ecosystem.

Throughout 2025, we’ve been traveling to key cities, bringing together experts, universities, entrepreneurs, and Web3 communities in curated spaces built for connection, education, and community building, turning curiosity into action and ideas into projects.

At each stop, we host dedicated dinners with speakers, foster intentional networking spaces, and amplify local communities, either showcasing existing ones or officially launching new nodes. Local talent leads presentations, and universities often participate with talks of their own.

- August 2: Chaco (https://lu.ma/mdrlsruk)

Each stop of the tour includes a mix between blockchain general fundamental talks and local community/zone topics. The general structure includes:
- Blockchain fundamentals and Ethereum smart contracts
- Tokenization and real-world assets (with a local industry focus)
- Professional opportunities in web3 and Road to Devconnect

- Networking space and open Q&A with speakers

The event is to launch our two new Argentinian tokenized products developed by R3al Blocks:

- XUUM Dynamic Building, a lifestyle and investment project located on the Argentine coast, designed to showcase how real estate tokenization can create new opportunities for access, liquidity, and financial innovation.

- Yerba Mate Tokenized, a cultural symbol of Argentina, now reimagined as a blockchain-based product that bridges tradition with cutting-edge technology.

This launch is more than a presentation of new products. It is a statement: Argentina is on-chain. By bringing real-world assets into the blockchain ecosystem, we aim to highlight how emerging markets like Argentina can use tokenization as a tool for growth, inclusion, and global visibility.

The event will combine live product demos, storytelling, and open dialogue with the community. Attendees will learn about the process of tokenizing assets, the opportunities it unlocks for investors and communities, and how projects from Latin America can add value to the Ethereum ecosystem.

Just as sharing a mate creates community in Argentina, we want this event to expand the circle globally, showing that blockchain is not only about technology, but also about culture, accessibility, and building bridges across borders.

Psychology for Founders is returning to Crecimiento AR for a second cycle of 5 talks. The series will focus on what's really happening on the inside while you're building, leading, or simply trying to sustain a project without losing yourself in the process.

This series is designed for founders, builders, creatives, people in the startup ecosystem, and anyone who feels that building something shouldn't require abandoning themselves.

We're bringing the topic of emotions to the table with Crecimiento because, when properly understood, your emotionality isn't an obstacle—it's your competitive advantage.

---

Regresa Psychology for Founders a Crecimiento AR, con un segundo ciclo de 5 charlas para hablar de lo que realmente pasa por dentro mientras emprendés, liderás o simplemente tratás de sostener un proyecto sin perderte a vos mismo en el intento.

​Stefan Meroslaw, psicólogo clínico y fundador de Mundo YÜ propone un espacio íntimo, donde cuestionar la forma en que tomamos decisiones, sostenemos la energía, gestionamos el miedo y regulamos nuestras emociones mientras tratamos de “hacer que ese algo funcione”.

target_audience: Curious people exploring the Web3 and Ethereum ecosystem who may feel intimidated by technical events. Participants who prefer learning through hands-on, creative, and collaborative experiences.
details:
We start with a collective mandala featuring Puqi and Mercurito on their way to Devconnect, where participants add colors and details as they arrive. A short talk on why Devconnect matters sets context for newcomers and curious minds.

Participants then illustrate glossary cards with Web3 terms and create a collaborative story chain, building a collective visual and narrative experience. A second talk reflects on Peruvian identity and representation, highlighting the importance of diverse voices in global Web3 spaces.

The highlight is painting 3D Mercurito miniatures, combining a Web3 word with a Peruvian cultural element, resulting in unique keepsakes that will travel to Devconnect Argentina.

We close with a ritual circle, sharing a word or wish to accompany the creations, which become part of the collective memory of the event.

About the Characters:
Mercurito – mascot of Mercurio Legacy, symbolizing curiosity, playfulness, and collective creation.
Puqi – a cultural bridge representing Peru’s creativity, roots, and journey into the global Ethereum community. Together, they embody the friendship between local identity and global innovation, walking side by side toward Devconnect.
name: Destino Devconnect: Art-Picnic in the Infinite Garden

details:
Psychology for Founders is returning to Crecimiento AR for a second cycle of 5 talks. The series will focus on what's really happening on the inside while you're building, leading, or simply trying to sustain a project without losing yourself in the process.

This series is designed for founders, builders, creatives, people in the startup ecosystem, and anyone who feels that building something shouldn't require abandoning themselves.

We're bringing the topic of emotions to the table with Crecimiento because, when properly understood, your emotionality isn't an obstacle—it's your competitive advantage.

---

Regresa Psychology for Founders a Crecimiento AR, con un segundo ciclo de 5 charlas para hablar de lo que realmente pasa por dentro mientras emprendés, liderás o simplemente tratás de sostener un proyecto sin perderte a vos mismo en el intento.

details:
This is a full blockchain conference on site at the University of Quilmes, a public universty in the Province of Buenos Aires that is helping students from the South of the province to get higher education.
We are introducing blockchain for the first time at a bigger in the university, by giving the first ever course of studies fully dedicated to blockchain. Now, we have the opportunity to schedule this conference that is open for all students in the campus, regardless of their field, to get their first contact with blockchain technology and get different points of views of how it is helping to transform our digital lives. 
Expected attendance is about 150 students. The University is in the process of scheduling and communicating the event internally.
